$Comment: The Christmas Ornament, the year's keepsake: Santa hands one over with the pay for Christmas Eve, once each Christmas, and it is never sold. A glass bauble to hang in the house. It wears the game's own Winter Bauble (WinterHoliday_Ornament_Bauble's model, its first texture and its icon), placed the way the game's bauble is, so it is its own item and a bauble from a present or a tree never counts as the keepsake. The quest's Claim row stamps each one with the year (StackNameKey keepsake.christmas_ornament.name in christmas.progression.lang), so the name here is the plain one a shop or a recipe would show.
